points.description: Names meteorological factors: wind speed AND vapour pressure (vapour pressure difference between water surface and air) — both correctly named.
points.partial_credit: Half marks if only one of wind speed or vapour pressure is given.

points.description: Names temperature (of water and air) AND atmospheric pressure as factors.
points.partial_credit: Half marks if only one of temperature or atmospheric pressure is given.

points.description: Names water-body factors: any of heat storage in the water body, water quality (salinity/dissolved solids), surface area.
points.partial_credit: Half marks if only one of the three is given; full if two or more are given.

rubric.notes: This is a list question: the mark follows how many of the seven listed factors are correctly named (wind speed, temperature, vapour pressure, atmospheric pressure, heat storage, water quality, surface area). Full 2 marks for roughly all items across the three groups; 1 mark if about half are right; 0 if none or the answer is unrelated. Clear synonyms are accepted (e.g. humidity or vapour pressure deficit for vapour pressure, salinity for water quality, area of water surface); a wrong extra item does not cancel correct ones.
